answer: Let each agent bond stake $s$ under slashing $\lambda$ plus a non-refundable attestation fee $f$; forging $n$ identities then costs $n(\lambda s+f)$ while opportunity cost compounds as $\sum r k$, so the echo of earlier forfeiture makes every fable of fresh identity dearer and steepens the marginal curve. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay of sequential compute $T$ resists parallelism, forcing $E[U]=pG-\lambda s<0$, so the ember of any collusion stays unprofitable and honest staking is the unique Nash equilibrium.
